# wallix-bastion_config_smtp (Data Source)

Get information on the global SMTP server configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Read the current global SMTP configuration
data "wallix-bastion_config_smtp" "current" {}

output "smtp_server" {
  value = "${data.wallix-bastion_config_smtp.current.server}:${data.wallix-bastion_config_smtp.current.port}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `authentication_method` (String)
- `certificate_hash` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `port` (Number)
- `postmaster_email` (String)
- `protocol` (String)
- `sender_email` (String)
- `sender_name` (String)
- `server` (String)
- `user` (String)

## Usage Notes

### No Lookup Key

`config_smtp` is a singleton: there is only one SMTP configuration on the Bastion, so this data
source takes **no arguments**. It always reads that single, global configuration — the same
configuration managed by the `wallix-bastion_config_smtp` resource, internally identified by the
fixed ID `smtpConfig`.

### Password Is Never Returned

`password` is not exposed by this data source's schema since the Bastion API never returns it on
read (it is write-only).
